hero.headline: Retail used cars on Frankford Ave
hero.sub: First Class Auto Land is a used car dealer on Frankford Avenue in Philadelphia. The work is retail used cars, sold from the lot at 4050 Frankford Ave. You come to see the inventory in person, pick a car that is actually on the ground, and deal with the lot that put it there.

items.title: Retail used cars
items.text: The dealer sells used cars at retail. You are buying a vehicle that is on the Frankford Avenue lot, not a brokered maybe from another state. The product is the car in front of you.

items.title: A lot you can walk
items.text: Retail means you walk the row. First Class Auto Land is set up as a dealer you visit, look at paint and miles, and decide with the car in daylight.

items.title: Frankford Avenue inventory
items.text: The address is the inventory. 4050 Frankford Ave is where the used cars sit. If a car matters, it matters because it is on that lot.

story.heading: A dealer on Frankford
paragraphs: Philadelphia already has plenty of used-car promises. First Class Auto Land keeps the claim small: retail used cars on Frankford Avenue. The lot is the offer. You do not need a myth about the brand. You need the car that is parked there.

A used car purchase works when you can see the vehicle, ask about that vehicle, and leave in that vehicle. The Frankford Avenue dealer is built around that sequence. No invented makes, no invented specials. The work is the lot.

items.title: Walk the retail lot
items.text: You start on the pavement at 4050 Frankford Ave. The used cars are the inventory. You look at the ones that are actually there.

items.title: Pick the car on the ground
items.text: Retail used cars means the decision is about a specific vehicle, not a catalog photo. You choose the car you can put a hand on.

items.title: Deal with the lot that holds it
items.text: The dealer that parked the car is the dealer you buy from. First Class Auto Land is the Frankford Avenue counter for that transaction.

feature.heading: Used cars, sold at retail
feature.text: The lot does not need a longer slogan. First Class Auto Land sells used cars at retail on Frankford Avenue. You come for a vehicle you can see.

spotlight.heading: The address is the showroom
spotlight.text: 4050 Frankford Ave is where the inventory lives. A used car dealer this straightforward wants you on the lot, looking at the row, before anyone talks paper.
